response.justification: A seasoned generalist engineer with ~15 years of production experience, staff-level titles, strong TypeScript/Node depth, and a genuine teaching/mentoring track record that would translate well to customer-facing technical leadership. However, the core requirement — 8+ years building production AI/GenAI solutions — is not met; AI-adjacent work appears only in the most recent role (~1.4 years) around MCP code generators and agentic tooling. The resume shows no Python, no RAG or vector database work, no LLM evaluation/observability, and only light cloud exposure (AWS CDK) rather than designing AI systems on a major cloud. Worth a screening call given the MCP and agent-infrastructure exposure plus strong engineering fundamentals, but he is a stretch for a Staff GenAI FDE hire unless the team is willing to trade AI depth for engineering breadth.
strengths: 15+ years shipping production systems; staff-level scope and full-stack breadth
Hands-on MCP and agentic-workflow tooling in current role — directly relevant tech
Proven communicator/mentor: conference talks, multi-day workshops, courses, TDD/CI advocacy
concerns: Falls well short of 8+ years building AI-driven solutions (~1.4 years AI-adjacent)
No evidence of RAG, vector databases, LLM metrics, or evaluation/observability pipelines
Python absent from skills; limited cloud AI architecture and data-pipeline evidence

key_factors.factor: Missing RAG / vector DB / cloud AI stack
Senior engineering breadth, MCP work, and mentoring/customer-facing aptitude
